product_summary: Vertical Form Fill Seal (VFFS) pouch packaging machines in six series — Orion, Prime, Ecoplus, SA, 3S, TSS — plus machine accessories/spare parts. In-house manufacturing at Plot No.377A, Road No.9, GIDC Kathwada, Ahmedabad-382 430, Gujarat. Machines are marketed for filling/sealing snacks & namkeen, tea & coffee, spices, grains & pulses, dry fruits, detergents, chemical powders, seeds/agro, confectionery & bakery, pet food. Source: https://pacepackaging.in/ and https://pacepackaging.in/products (product menu lists 'VFFS Machines' and 'Accessories' only).
comment: HS 842230 ('machinery for filling, closing, sealing, capsuling or labelling bottles, cans, boxes, bags or other containers') matches the declared code exactly: the entire catalogue is VFFS bag/pouch form-fill-seal machinery, which is the textbook 8422.30 article. No HS correction needed. Industry_claimed 'Продукты питания и FMCG' is an industry misclassification: the company does not produce food or FMCG goods — it builds packaging machinery sold TO food/FMCG producers. Correct industry is mechanical engineering / packaging machinery (HS chapter 84), not food. Trader signs: none observed — the site states in-house manufacturing, R&D and assembly ('100 In-house Engineering', '5000+ VFFS Packaging Machines installed'), ISO 9001:2015 claimed; no reseller/import-agent language found. Product lines missing from the declaration: accessories and spare parts for VFFS machines (forming tubes, seal jaws, etc.) are sold separately and would fall under parts headings (e.g. 8422.90 for parts of 8422 machines) rather than 8422.30 — worth flagging if the declaration covers only complete machines. All product claims above are from the company's own website and catalogue only; no customs line, B/L or shipping record was checked in this task, therefore the actual export of these machines is 'заявлено, не подтверждено'. Note: the site advertises participation in RosUpack 2025 (Moscow) and Gulfood Manufacturing 2026, which is a marketing claim, not shipment evidence. No registry, revenue or customs-volume research performed per role scope.
